programmes.d: An epidemic of poison-pen letters brings Miss Marple to the village of Lymston.

Intrigue abounds as an advertisement predicts a murder at Little Paddocks.
Miss Marple finds that the more she knows, the more everything is shrouded in doubt.
Just as Miss Marple gets closer to solving the case, she suddenly disappears.
Miss Marple hears of a double murder on the radio and the connection to her is clear.
The police dismiss Miss Marple's warning of another murder, until a body is found.
Dolphin Cove local royalty Stuart Granger washes ashore with a knife in his back.
A famous wellness influencer drops dead in the middle of a packed fun run.

A tense game of lawn bowls turns to chaos when a player is killed on the green.
